projectDescription.text: We are our city's police department, and our project is a new, data-driven traffic safety enforcement program targeting speeding and aggressive driving on our ten highest-crash corridors. We will use crash and speed data to determine where and when to patrol, adjust patrols as crash patterns change over time, and structure the approach so that other departments can replicate it. We have three years of crash data for these corridors, and a state university has agreed to evaluate the program's results. Design and environmental review for the project are complete, and the project is construction-ready. We are requesting about $1.8 million in federal funding to support this program over three years.
